notes.title: [Temporary Maintenance Notice]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653720/484a03e0d5b7b09467fb36fc3dadb0fa3022f098.png[/img]
[b][Temporary Maintenance Notice][/b]

We will be performing temporary maintenance ahead of the Playtest.

[b]🛠️ Maintenance Schedule[/b]
[list]
[*] UTC: September 19, 2025, 10:00 – 12:00
[*] PDT (US West, e.g. Los Angeles): Sep 19, 03:00 – 05:00
[*] EDT (US East, e.g. New York): Sep 19, 06:00 – 08:00
[*] BST (UK, e.g. London): Sep 19, 11:00 – 13:00
[*] 
[/list]

This maintenance is part of our final preparations to ensure a stable and smooth experience during the playtest.

Please note that the game will be unavailable during the maintenance window.
Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to seeing you soon in Super-B!

notes.title: 🎮 The First [Super-B] Playtest Begins! 🚀✨
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656160/92f333e9f5b1533c96e945c82069c56a05aa6b7e.png"][/img][/p][p]First of all, thank you to everyone who pre-registered and patiently waited—
we’re excited to finally kick off the very first [b]Super-B Playtest[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]Super-B[/b] is a vibrant social playground where you can hang out with friends, customize your look, decorate your own space, and compete in fun mini-games.[/p][p]
 In this playtest, you’ll get an early taste of some of these features.[/p][h2]
[b]📅 Playtest Schedule[/b][/h2][h3][b]👕 Early Character Creation (Starting Sep 18, 00:00 UTC)[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Lobby Access[/p][/*][*][p]Character customization[/p][/*][*][p]🎁 Check-in Event begins -> Participants will receive [b]Playtest Gold + NSB[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎮 Main Playtest (Sep 23, 00:00 UTC – Sep 24, 23:59 UTC)[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Early Access content & 🎁 Check-in Event remain available[/p][/*][*][p]Home decoration (My Home)[/p][/*][*][p]Match-based mini-games, including:
[/p][list][*][p]Battle Royale[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Royale Island[/p][/*][*][p]Team Deathmatch[/p][/*][*][p]Capture the Flag[/p][/*][*][p]Bomb Defusal[/p][/*][*][p]Obstacle Races[/p][/*][*][p]Hide & Seek[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]This is the very first time [b]Super-B[/b] is going live on Steam.
 Your feedback will play a huge role in helping us prepare for the full release.[/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter bugs or have suggestions, please share them on the Steam Community Hub—we’ll be reading everything![/p][p][/p][p][b]⚠️ Notice[/b]
All items, rank progress, and most data from this Playtest will be reset once the test ends.[/p][p]However, as a special perk for Playtest participants, [b]your NSB will carry over[/b].
NSB will be converted into in-game currency when the full launch goes live.[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon in the game! 💙[/p][p]
[/p]
